title: Automatic split-generation and the quantum-cohomology factor from a smooth Lagrangian endomorphism algebra
author: Jack Smith
work: Quantum cohomology and Fukaya summands from monotone Lagrangian tori
source_version: Journal de l’École polytechnique—Mathématiques 12 (2025), 287–318; DOI 10.5802/jep.290; published 2025-02-18
difficulty_reason: The seven conclusions are connected by the Shklyarov pairing, open–closed isometry, weak proper Calabi–Yau duality, and the Hochschild module action. The proof constructs the two-sided quantum-cohomology factors Q and Q-perp, identifies the closed–open kernel, and proves split-generation by the resulting idempotent through Abouzaid’s criterion. Smoothness, Morita invariance and these categorical compatibility arguments exceed ordinary PhD qualifying-exam symplectic topology, while their cited standard foundations are kept distinct from Smith’s source-local construction.
